snippet.title: Darfall - Release Date Announcement (Lore Trailer)
snippet.description:
Darfall Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1961600/Darfall/

You never know how the story will end. But you have to take the risk.
Just remember - the night is always darkest before the dawn.

🏰 What is Darfall? 🏰

- Choose and level up your hero with powerful abilities and perks
- Loot epic and legendary items to boost your hero’s stats
- Build and expand your city while managing resources and crafting items
- Brace yourself for the night when undead waves rise to attack
- Experience handcrafted story missions in the full release
- Create custom maps with our easy-to-use Map Editor and share them via mod.io

🎮 Play the Free Demo Today:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2085150/Darfall_Demo/

💬 Join to get latest updates:
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/Pz9kpaQ88b
Twitter: https://x.com/SquareNite

Why Darfall?
Combining city-building and RPG hero mechanics, Darfall offers deep strategy, rich fantasy lore, and customizable gameplay. Whether you're managing resources or commanding armies, every decision counts.

📅 Wishlist Darfall on Steam and stay tuned for more updates!

#Darfall #IndieGame #CityBuilder #RTS #RPG #FantasyGames #Modding #GameDev #Gaming
